title: Overwatch Patch Notes – November 14, 2018
raw_text: November 14, 2018 Overwatch Patch Notes – November 14, 2018 A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES General Fixed a visual bug that prevented “The Boo!” Spray from properly showing Fixed a bug to reduce AMD device-lost errors Fixed a bug to reduce load failures into game on under minimum spec systems Top of post
